resources.string: Use phone speaker when headphones are unavailable
Off by default. Speaker playback is audible to others. Avoids Bluetooth output buffering, but network delay and stutters can remain.
Audio from this Mac can play aloud if headphones are missing or disconnect. This is not private. Turning this off during listening stops playback.
Playing on phone speaker — not private
Connect headphones or allow speaker fallback below. Start listening on your Mac.
Connect your trusted Mac over LAN.

Connecting local network (Wi-Fi)… Audio unlocks once LAN secures.
Automatic LAN is on. Keep Bluetooth connected on the same Wi-Fi with automatic LAN enabled on your Mac, or tap Connect LAN to retry.
Automatic LAN is off. Enable it on both devices over Wi-Fi, or tap Connect LAN manually.

Sends eligible media/game playback to Mac. Calls, microphone audio and opted-out apps are excluded by Android. The phone keeps playing (connect earphones or a quiet adapter to the phone to silence its speaker without muting Mac audio); Mac speakers may be audible to others.
Only audio is sent. Android requires its screen-capture consent prompt each session; the grant is never saved.
